content: Tɔmbɑ Yoɑkɑsi, Yosiɑsin bii suɑ mɑ bɑ nùn kuɑ sunɔ win tundon ɑyerɔ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ.
Yoɑkɑsi u mɔwɑ wɔ̃ɔ yɛndɑ itɑ sɑnɑm mɛ u bɑndu di Yudɑɔ. Mɑ u kuɑ suru itɑ bɑn te sɔɔ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ.
Eɡibitin sunɔwɑ u nùn bɑndu yɑrɑ. Mɑ u win tɔmbu sii ɡeesun tɔnnu itɑ kɑ wurɑn kilo tɛnɑ bure bu kɔsiɑ wɔ̃ɔ kɑ wɔ̃ɔ.
Yen biruwɑ u Yoɑkɑsi win wɔnɔ, Eliɑkimu suɑ u kɔsire kuɑ bɑndu sɔɔ. Mɑ u nùn yĩsi kpɑɑru kɑ̃ Yoyɑkimu. Mɑ u Yoɑkɑsi suɑ u kɑ dɑ Eɡibitiɔ.
Yoyɑkimu
u kuɑ Yudɑbɑn sinɑ boko
Yoyɑkimu u mɔwɑ wɔ̃ɔ yɛndɑ nɔɔbu sɑnɑm mɛ u bɑndu di Yudɑɔ, mɑ u kuɑ wɔ̃ɔ wɔkurɑ tiɑ bɑndu sɔɔ. Kɔ̃sɑ u kuɑ Gusunɔ win Yinnin nɔni sɔɔ.
Yerɑ sɔ̃ɔ teeru Bɑbilonin sinɑ boko, Nɛbukɑnɛsɑɑ u nɑ u Yoyɑkimu tɑbu wɔri. Mɑ u nùn mwɑ u bɔkuɑ kɑ sii ɡɑndun yɔni u kɑ dɑ Bɑbiloniɔ.
Nɛbukɑnɛsɑɑ u Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerun dendi yɑ̃nu ɡurɑ u kɑ dɑ u yi win sinɑ kpɑɑrɔ.
Ye Yoyɑkimu u kuɑn sukum kɑ kɔ̃sɑ ye u kuɑ, ye kpuron ɡɑri yi yoruɑ Isirelibɑ kɑ Yudɑbɑn sinɑmbun fɑɑɡin tireru sɔɔ. Yen biru, win bii Yoyɑkiniwɑ u bɑndu kɔsire kuɑ.
Yoyɑkini
u kuɑ Yudɑbɑn sinɑ boko
Wɔ̃ɔ nɔɔbɑ itɑwɑ
Yoyɑkini u mɔ sɑɑ ye u bɑndu di. Mɑ u kuɑ suru itɑ kɑ sɔ̃ɔ wɔkuru bɑn te sɔɔ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ. Kɔ̃sɑ u kuɑ Yinni Gusunɔn nɔni sɔɔ.

Ye n kuɑ wɔ̃ɔ kpɔɔ, yerɑ Nɛbukɑnɛsɑɑ Bɑbilonin sinɑ boko u nɑ u Yoyɑkini mwɑ u kɑ dɑ Bɑbiloniɔ. Mɑ u Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerun dendi yɑ̃nu ɡɑnu ɡurɑ. Mɑ u Yoyɑkinin bɑɑ yɑ̃kɑbu Sedesiɑsi kuɑ sunɔ Yudɑbɑn suunu sɔɔ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ.
Sedesiɑsi u bɑndu di Yudɑɔ
Sedesiɑsi u mɔwɑ wɔ̃ɔ yɛndɑ tiɑ sɑnɑm mɛ u bɑndu di Yudɑɔ. Mɑ u kuɑ wɔ̃ɔ wɔkurɑ tiɑ bɑn te sɔɔ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ.
Kɔ̃sɑ u kuɑ Gusunɔ win Yinnin wuswɑɑɔ. U ǹ tii kɑwe Gusunɔn sɔmɔ Yeremin wuswɑɑɔ wi u rɑ nùn Yinni Gusunɔn ɡɑri sɔ̃.
U swɑɑ tɑɑyɑ, mɑ u ɡɔ̃ru bɔbiɑ. U ǹ win ɡɔ̃ru wesie Gusunɔ Isirelibɑn Yinnin mi ɡiɑ. U mɑm Nɛbukɑnɛsɑɑ seesiwɑ wi u nùn bɔ̃rusiɑ kɑ Yinni Gusunɔn yĩsiru sɑnɑm mɛ bɑ ɑrukɑwɑni bɔkumɔ.
Yɑ̃ku kowobun wiruɡibu kɑ Yudɑ be bɑ tie kpuro bɑ kɔ̃sɑ kuɑ yɑ kpɑ̃. Domi bɑ tɔn tukobun komɑnu swĩi. Mɑ bɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yeru disi doke te u ɡɔsɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ.
N deemɑ Gusunɔ ben bɑɑbɑbɑn Yinni wi, u bu kirɔ kuɑ yee yellun di sɑɑ win sɔmɔbun min di. Domi u kĩ u win tɔmbu kɑ win sɑ̃ɑ yee te fɑɑbɑ ko.
Adɑmɑ bɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɔmɔ be yɛ̃ɛ bɑ yɑɑkoru koosi. Bɑ ben ɡɑri ɑtɑfiiru kuɑ sere Yinni Gusunɔn tii u kɑ bu mɔru kuɑ ye bɑ ǹ kpɛ̃ bu suresiɑ.

Yerɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u derɑ Nɛbukɑnɛsɑɑ, Bɑbilonin sinɑ boko u bu tɑbu wɔri, mɑ u ben ɑluwɑɑsibɑ tɑkobinu sɔkurɑ u ɡo ben sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ. U ǹ ɡoo deri, ɑluwɑɑsibɑ kɑ wɔndiɑbɑ kɑ durɔ tɔkɔnu. Be kpurowɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u bɛri win nɔmɑɔ.
Nɛbukɑnɛsɑɑ u Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerun ɑrumɑni ɡurɑ bɑkɑ kɑ piibu kɑ ben sinɑ kpɑɑrun ɑrumɑni kɑ sinɑ bokon tiiɡiɑ kɑ sere mɑɑ win sinɑ bwɑ̃ɑbuɡiɑ.
Mɑ bɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yeru kɑ Yerusɑlɛmun dii ɡeenu dɔ̃ɔ sɔkɑ. Mɑ bɑ yen ɡɑ̃ɑ ɡeenu kɔsukɑ. Mɑ bɑ yen ɡbɑ̃rɑru surɑ.
Nɛbukɑnɛsɑɑ u be bɑ ǹ ɡo tɑbu sɔɔ ɡurɑ u kɑ dɑ Bɑbiloniɔ. Mɑ bɑ kuɑ wi kɑ win bibun yobu sere Pɛɛsibɑ bɑ kɑ bɑndu di.

Nɡe mɛyɑ Yinni Gusunɔn ɡɑri yi kɑ koorɑ yi win sɔmɔ Yeremi u rɑɑ ɡeruɑ u nɛɛ, bɑ koo Yudɑbɑ yoru mwɑ kpɑ tem mɛ, mu wɑ mu sɑnɑm wɛ̃rɑɡim di kpɑ mu wɛ̃rɑ sere wɔ̃ɔ wɑtɑ kɑ wɔkuru, wɑhɑlɑ ye mu rɑɑ wɑn sɔ̃.
Sirusi u Yudɑbɑ woodɑ wɛ̃
bu wurɑ ben temɔ

Sirusi, Pɛɛsin sinɑ bokon bɑndun wɔ̃ɔ ɡbiikuu sɔɔ, yerɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u ɡɔ̃ru doke u win ɡɑri yibiɑ yi u rɑɑ ɡeruɑ sɑɑ win ɡɔro Yeremin nɔɔn di. Mɑ u doke Sirusin ɡɔ̃ruɔ bu kɑ ɡɑri yini yore. Mɑ bɑ yi kpɑrɑ win tem kpuro sɔɔ.

Yi nɛɛ, ɑmɛniwɑ Sirusi, Pɛɛsin sinɑ boko u ɡeruɑ. U nɛɛ, Gusunɔ Wɔrukoo u mɑn hɑnduniɑn bɑnnu kpuro wɛ̃. Mɑ u mɑn yiire n nùn sɑ̃ɑ yeru bɑniɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ Yudɑbɑn temɔ. Yen sɔ̃, be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Isirelibɑ kpuro bu wuro Yerusɑlɛmuɔ kpɑ Gusunɔ ben Yinni u n kɑ bu wɑ̃ɑ.

footnotes.text: wɔ̃ɔ nɔɔbɑ itɑwɑ - Sinɑmbu II, 24:8 yɑ nɛɛ, Yoyɑkini u mɔwɑ wɔ̃ɔ wɔkurɑ nɔɔbu kɑ itɑ sɑnɑm mɛ u bɑndu di.
